warnings: Same grid as S-04 (floor1) — every hatched-node position matches the floor1 sheet's grid1-4 x rowF-A footprint, cross-checked. Row E here is uniformly 'B2' across all three segments (1-2, 2-3, 3-4), unlike floor1's row E which used B1 for the middle segment — read directly off this sheet's own labels, not carried over from S-04.

The stair-landing corner (grid4/grid4', rows D-C) explicitly labels its landing-level beam 'B1' at the D4/D4' node ('B1ที่ระดับชานพัก') and both 'B4X' and 'B1' at the C4/C4' node ('B4X/B1ที่ระดับชานพัก') — recorded D4-D4' as B1 and C4-C4' as B4X per the printed label order, both understood to be the same physical landing-beam junction referenced from floor1's B4X/B3X marks below and floor2's own B1/B2 marks meeting it.

Grid2's D-C vertical (between the two dashed S1 sub-rooms) has no clearly legible independent mark at this resolution — carried forward as 'B5' by continuity with the E2-D2 segment above, same low-confidence call made on S-04; a higher-resolution re-read of the source PDF would settle it.

The linework north of row F IS a beam rectangle and is now recorded, same correction as on S-04/floor1: a B2 along dummy row F' from grid2 to grid4 (5.00m) with a printed 'B2X' spur at each end dropping the dimensioned 1.00m to row F. The earlier 'fascia/reference line' judgment was wrong — the 1.00 is the first segment of this sheet's own vertical dimension chain and both spurs carry their own marks. Note the F' beam is marked B2 here, where floor1 marks its equivalent B3.

Floor2 overhangs 0.60m WEST of grid1 between rows E and B — the opening segment of this sheet's x-chain. Its west edge beam runs on dummy line 1' (E1'-D1'-C1'-B1'), grid1 itself carries NO beam over that stretch, and three printed 'B4X' spurs close the overhang back to the grid1 columns at rows D, C and B. The row-E beam also runs 0.60m past grid1 to the corner where the 1' line starts (recorded as its own E1'-E1 segment per the atomic-splitting rule). An earlier read placed the whole west edge on grid1 and omitted the spurs; this differs from floor1, where the same 0.60 overhang only appears at rows C-B.

Two 'B1' beams divide the upper bathrooms and were both missing: one vertical on the 2.00 dummy line 1" between rows D and C (splitting the two S1 rooms in the grid1-2 bay), and one horizontal in the grid2-3 bay between rows E and D. The second sits on a row the sheet never dimensions; a pixel scan places it at 4.35 and it is recorded on dummy row E" (distinct from floor1's E' at 4.05 — the two are 0.30m apart, see grid master). Its span (grid2 to grid3) is exact either way. Re-reading those labels at high zoom also showed the row-D grid2-3 segment is marked B1, not B2.
'ST'/'ลง' (going down) stair symbol confirms this is the top of the stair run down to floor 1, matching S-11/S-12's rebar detail for the same stair.

The B-A band is split into two S1 bathrooms by a labelled 'B2' beam that floor1 does not have — confirmed by pixel-scanning both sheets over the same band: floor2 shows three beam-face pairs (row B, the divider, row A) where floor1 shows only two. Recorded on dummy row B'.
